mapper.select: SELECT s.article_id AS articleId, s.total_count AS totalCount FROM tb_article_daily_stats s INNER JOIN ( SELECT article_id, MAX(stat_date) AS maxDate FROM tb_article_daily_stats WHERE deleted = 0 AND stat_date < #{date} GROUP BY article_id ) t ON s.article_id = t.article_id AND s.stat_date = t.maxDate WHERE s.deleted = 0
